zh.title: 海巡國慶展演首秀JUMP 20無人機與MARTAC T-24無人艇
zh.summary: 海巡國慶首度展示無人機艇；管碧玲說明海空一體三大轉型
body: 海委會主委管碧玲今天表示，海巡署將推動全新造艦、升級情監偵系統及導入無人載具等3大轉型。其中JUMP 20無人機及MARTAC T-24無人艇將於今年國慶海巡2026傳真海演展演首度亮相。
海巡署指出，今年為海巡成立以來最大規模國慶參演，將出動2艘突擊艇、1艘MARTAC無人艇、1架JUMP 20無人機，以及機動雷達車、紅外線熱影像車等裝備。
管碧玲指出，國慶將首度公開亮相的JUMP 20無人機具備高空偵巡策能力，最高飛行高度達1萬7000公尺。海委會副主委兼海巡署長張忠龍表示，JUMP 20無人機及MARTAC T-24無人艇主要用於長距離偵搜及遠距救護。

en.title: CGA to debut JUMP 20 UAV and MARTAC T-24 USV at National Day parade
en.summary: CGA to debut JUMP 20 UAV and MARTAC T-24 USV; 3-part transformation announced
body: Ocean Affairs Council Minister Kuan Pi-ling said today that the Coast Guard Administration (CGA) will advance three major transformations: building new ships, upgrading surveillance systems and introducing unmanned vehicles. The JUMP 20 UAV and MARTAC T-24 USV will make their debut at this year's National Day parade.

The CGA stated that this year's participation is the largest since its founding, involving 2 assault boats, 1 MARTAC USV, 1 JUMP 20 UAV, plus mobile radar vehicles and infrared thermal imaging vehicles.

Kuan noted that the JUMP 20, which will be publicly revealed at National Day, has high-altitude surveillance capability with a maximum flight altitude of 17,000 meters. CGA Director-General Chung Chung-tao stated that the JUMP 20 UAV and MARTAC T-24 USV are mainly for long-range reconnaissance and long-distance rescue.
